title: Security Finding
description: A single structured security finding produced by a red team agent. This is the source of truth — all reports are rendered from findings, never hand-authored.

id.description: Stable finding ID. Format: AZ-<DOMAIN>-<NNN>, e.g. AZ-STOR-001

title.description: Short, specific title of the finding

confidence.description: Confidence that this finding is a true positive

category.description: Domain category, e.g. Storage, Identity, Network, RBAC, Compute, Database, Logging

check_id.description: ID of the check that produced this finding, e.g. CHK-STOR-PUBLIC-BLOB

finding_class.description: Stable identifier for the KIND of misconfiguration (derived from the check), e.g. 'storage-public-blob'. All affected resources sharing this class on the same logical scope collapse into ONE finding. See knowledge/scaling.md.

dedupe_key.description: Deterministic key used to merge/resume findings without creating duplicates across shards or re-runs. Convention: '<finding_class>:<subscription_id>' (or '<finding_class>:<scope_hash>' for tenant-wide findings).

resource_id.description: Full Azure resource ID of the REPRESENTATIVE affected resource (the first/most-exposed instance). Kept for backward compatibility; when affected_resources[] is present, this MUST equal the resource_id of one of its entries.

affected_resources.description: Full list of resource instances exhibiting this finding class. Aggregation is always on: a single-resource finding is simply the N=1 case (one entry matching resource_id). Only aggregate HOMOGENEOUS findings (same class, severity, confidence, remediation, attack-path role, and logical scope) — see knowledge/scaling.md.

resource_id.description: Full Azure resource ID of this affected instance

evidence_ref.description: Optional pointer into engagements/<session>/evidence/raw/ (gitignored) specific to this instance

description.description: What the issue is and why it matters

attack_vector.description: How an attacker would exploit this, e.g. 'Public exposure -> unauthenticated data access'

risk.description: Business and technical risk if exploited

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the finding. At least one item required; never include secret values.

source.description: Azure tool/API that produced the evidence, e.g. 'azure-storage account get' or 'Azure Resource Graph'

attack_path.description: Ordered steps if this finding is part of a multi-step compromise chain
